definition: The ADR price divided by the dollar value of the local shares it represents (local price × depositary ratio × FX), minus one.
How many local ordinary shares one ADR represents. Toyota: 10. AstraZeneca: 0.5.
The pair's typical premium, measured as its trailing median. It absorbs persistent frictions such as ownership limits, fees and borrow scarcity.
Today's deviation from the structural basis divided by the standard deviation of past deviations. |z| ≥ 2 is unusual.
How many trading days a deviation has historically taken to shrink by half, estimated from an AR(1) fit.
LIVE: both legs fresh. PROXY: the local market is closed, so its last close is used at live FX. STALE: a price is older than 30 minutes. DEMO: synthetic data.
Net asset value per fund share. NAV is struck at the close; iNAV is an intraday estimate. The ETF Monitor uses the issuer's prior-close NAV.
How the fair value for a fund was built. Here: NAV (prior close), because free data has no intraday iNAV.
The volatility of the difference between a fund's return and its index's return.
The average of standardized ROE, operating margin and (inverted) leverage within a peer group.
The gap between a company's log multiple and the multiple its quality would justify in the peer regression. Negative is cheap.
A grade stored with the data available when it was computed and never restated with hindsight.
A trade post whose entry price was captured by the platform from market data at the moment of posting and cannot be edited.
The value of a key driver (growth, margin) that makes the DCF value equal the market price: what the market is implicitly assuming.
How far below estimated value the price sits. ValueBot scales the required margin with the uncertainty of the valuation.
